title: Lake Louise Moraine Emerald Lake Johnston Canyon Banff Yoho Tour
includes: Admission to Emerald Lake & Natural Bridge from Oct 13 - May 31 only
Choose either Bow Falls or Banff Avenue at the last stop
In winter, crampons will be provided and use at your own responsibility
Admission to Moraine Lake & Vermilion Lakes from June 1 - Oct 12 only
Suggested guide tips ($12 cash per person) (not included)
Meals (Pack your own lunch or buy grab-and-go lunch at Lake Louise or Moraine Lake) (not included)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
policies: Pack your own lunch or buy grab-and-go lunch at Lake Louise or Moraine Lake
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Explore the breathtaking beauty of Banff National Park in total comfort. Travel in an air-conditioned vehicle with a knowledgeable local guide who brings the journey to life through personal stories, insider tips, and recommendations for the best photo opportunities. It’s the perfect stress-free way to experience Banff’s highlights in just one day—no planning or navigating required.

Experience the best of Banff in a full-day guided tour.

Visit the region’s most iconic lakes, including the breathtaking Lake Louise and Moraine Lake (replaced by Banff Avenue from October 14 to May 31), Emerald Lake, Natural Bridge. Enjoy a scenic hike through Johnston Canyon, one of Banff’s most popular trails, and wrap up your day with Vermilion Lakes (replaced by Bow Falls from October 14 to May 31)
